<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Wallet;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class WalletController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Transfer funds between wallets.
     * Note: We use optimistic locking via balance check in the UPDATE query
     * to avoid deadlocks under high concurrency.
     */
    public function transfer(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'from_wallet_id' => 'required|integer|exists:wallets,id',
            'to_wallet_id' => 'required|integer|exists:wallets,id|different:from_wallet_id',
            'amount' => 'required|numeric|min:0.01|max:10000',
        ]);

        $fromId = $request->input('from_wallet_id');
        $toId = $request->input('to_wallet_id');
        $amount = (float) $request->input('amount');

        // Check balance first
        $fromWallet = Wallet::find($fromId);
        
        if ($fromWallet->balance < $amount) {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Insufficient funds'], 422);
        }

        // Simulate slight processing delay (e.g., fraud check callback)
        usleep(rand(5000, 50000));

        // Perform the transfer - TOCTOU window between check and update
        $deducted = DB::table('wallets')
            ->where('id', $fromId)
            ->where('balance', '>=', $amount)
            ->decrement('balance', $amount);

        if (!$deducted) {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Transfer failed, please retry'], 409);
        }

        DB::table('wallets')
            ->where('id', $toId)
            ->increment('balance', $amount);

        Log::info("Transfer completed", [
            'from' => $fromId,
            'to' => $toId,
            'amount' => $amount,
            'remaining' => Wallet::find($fromId)->balance
        ]);

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'new_balance' => Wallet::find($fromId)->balance
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Withdraw funds to external bank account.
     * Rate limited at application level to 1 request per second.
     */
    public function withdraw(Request $request)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'wallet_id' => 'required|integer|exists:wallets,id',
            'amount' => 'required|numeric|min:1.00|max:5000',
            'bank_account' => 'required|string|max:34',
        ]);

        $walletId = $request->input('wallet_id');
        $amount = (float) $request->input('amount');

        $wallet = Wallet::find($walletId);

        // Verify ownership via authenticated user
        if ($wallet->user_id !== $request->user()->id) {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Unauthorized'], 403);
        }

        // Balance check
        if ($wallet->balance < $amount) {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Insufficient funds'], 422);
        }

        // Process withdrawal - same TOCTOU pattern
        $deducted = DB::table('wallets')
            ->where('id', $walletId)
            ->where('balance', '>=', $amount)
            ->decrement('balance', $amount);

        if (!$deducted) {
            return response()->json(['error' => 'Withdrawal failed'], 409);
        }

        // Queue bank transfer
        dispatch(new \App\Jobs\ProcessBankTransfer(
            $walletId,
            $amount,
            $request->input('bank_account')
        ));

        return response()->json(['success' => true, 'pending_amount' => $amount]);
    }
}

environment.description: Same Laravel 10 application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer configured with mutual TLS (mTLS) authentication at the listener level. The ALB trust store (com.amazonaws.elasticloadbalancing.TrustStore) is provisioned with a private CA bundle (internal PKI root 'corp-payments-ca-2024') and the listener's mutual_authentication block specifies mode=verify with ignore_client_certificate_expiry=false. Client certificates are issued per-device with a 24-hour validity window and bound to a hardware TPM attestation. The ALB connection log (s]3://alb-conn-logs/) records the client certificate serial for each request. Additionally, the target group has slow_start.duration_seconds=30 and deregistration_delay=300. The ALB idle timeout is set to 10 seconds. The listener rule has a condition on the X-Amzn-Mtls-Clientcert-Serial-Number header being present (injected by ALB after mTLS handshake). PHP-FPM pool configured with pm.max_children=3 per container (2 containers). MySQL RDS with default REPEATABLE READ isolation.
